properties.text: A read-only session viewer: readOnly hides the composer and starts no transport. This example pre-populates a transcript via properties.content (a preview / testing convenience only). In production a host restores a saved session at runtime by injecting it into states["content"] via setElementState, after the interface is built.

message.text: How do I reverse a string in Swift?
The user wants string reversal; String has a reversed() that returns a ReversedCollection, wrap it in String().

Use `String(s.reversed())`:

```swift
let s = "hello"
let r = String(s.reversed()) // "olleh"
```
